Captain America and the Avengers.name: Captain America and the Avengers
Captain America and the Avengers.summary: The Captain America and the Avengers port for the Nintendo Entertainment System.

Galactic Crusader.name: Galactic Crusader
Galactic Crusader.summary: Your starship is alive - a metamorphic creature that can transform from a huge flying insect into a metallic destroyer! Penetrate squadron after squadron of bizarre alien fortifications. March onward to a final confrontation against an all-powerful enemy!

Spiritual Warfare.name: Spiritual Warfare
Spiritual Warfare.summary: A Legend of Zelda inspired game in which the player guides a character who converts non-believers, fights demons, and ultimately goes up against Satan himself.
